info.name: Pinterest - Astro 6 (Working Progress Currently)
info.description:
This theme originally was called "Pinterest Dark and Purple theme" and now changed to the current name you see in the title to "Astro 6" And this is the Sixth version of the theme Updated on (April / 21 / 2025) to support the latest Pinterest UI update, Providing better animations, Colors and a darker theme! Enjoy.

Key Features:
Rich Dark Aesthetic – A deeper, more polished dark mode with refined purple accents.

UI Improvements – Customized elements, better corner styling, and cohesive color adjustments.

Enhanced Animations – Smother transitions and interactions for a seamless browsing experience.

Optimized for Pinterest – Fully compatible with the latest layout updates.
